milestone.title: clippy: resolve too_many_arguments warnings in mp + raul (clean base for M-Clippy adopt)

intent.outcome: All pre-existing too_many_arguments clippy warnings are resolved via config/options structs, giving M-Clippy (the clippy adopt milestone) a clean deny baseline with zero inherited warnings.

problem.description: clippy reports too_many_arguments (8/7, 9/7, 12/7) on cmd_path (12 args), cmd_init (8 args), cmd_list_steps (9 args), and render_tree in path_graph.rs (7 args). These make a clippy --deny baseline unenforceable — the first CI run would fail on these warnings before any new code is added.

in_scope: Extract PathOptions struct for cmd_path (crates/mp/src/commands/path.rs) to reduce from 12 to 1 parameter
Extract InitOptions struct for cmd_init (crates/mp/src/commands/init.rs) to reduce from 8 to 1 parameter
Extract ListStepsOptions struct for cmd_list_steps (crates/mp/src/commands/list.rs) to reduce from 9 to 1 parameter
Refactor render_tree inner fn (crates/raul/src/path_graph.rs) to capture id_to_item and children_of via closure, reducing params from 7 to 5
cargo clippy exits 0 on mp + raul; no warnings
out_of_scope: Changing any function behavior — this is a pure signature refactor
Fixing other clippy warning categories (auto-fixable, doc, etc.) — handled in M-Clippy
Changes to call sites beyond updating the argument打包

acceptance_criteria.description: render_chain_lane (crates/raul/src/path_graph.rs:148) refactored to capture id_to_item via closure rather than passing it as a parameter; the function signature is (out: &mut String, items: &[serde_json::Value]) — 2 params, with id_to_item and ordered computed in-scope and used by inner closures. The closure pattern subsumes the prior 7-param render_tree refactor described in M98-era specs.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: M127 verified 2026-07-08 on master: cargo clippy -p raul --all-targets exits 0. NOTE: AC-04 description references 'render_tree inner fn' that does not exist; the closure-capture pattern it describes is implemented in crates/raul/src/path_graph.rs::render_chain_lane (line 148, 2 params, captures id_to_item via closure). Filed F-01 to amend AC-04 description.

acceptance_criteria.description: Full baseline: cargo clippy --all-targets exits 0 on both mp and raul (or -D warnings via a clippy.toml config if denylist-style suppression is preferred). The too_many_arguments warnings for cmd_path, cmd_init, cmd_list_steps, and render_tree are resolved. No other clippy warnings are in scope for this milestone.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: M127 verified 2026-07-08 on master: cargo clippy --all-targets exits 0 on both mp and raul. No clippy.toml denylist configured; clean baseline achieved via the three struct extractions (AC-01..AC-03) plus status.rs unused-import fix.

work_packages.name: render_tree: closure capture to reduce from 7 to 5 params
work_packages.goal: Refactor the inner render_tree fn (crates/raul/src/path_graph.rs:116) which takes 7 parameters (out, id, children_of, id_to_item, prefix, is_last, visited). Make id_to_item and children_of captured by the inner closure rather than passed as parameters, reducing to 5 explicit params (out, id, prefix, is_last, visited). findings.description: M127 AC-04 description references a 'render_tree inner fn' (7 params -> 5 via closure capture) that does not exist in the current code. The closure-capture pattern it describes is implemented in render_chain_lane (crates/raul/src/path_graph.rs:148, 2 params, captures id_to_item via closure). The verification (cargo clippy -p raul --all-targets exits 0) passes. AC-04 description should be amended to reflect actual state — either the refactor was renamed/subsumed by M125's path_graph rewrite, or the description was aspirational. Remediation: update AC-04 description in master-plan/milestones/127-...json to point at render_chain_lane and capture the closure pattern there (param count 2, no explicit id_to_item param).
